msg.stta.no_mic: No microphone available! Pick one in the setup screen.
msg.stta.no_server: Speech engine not reachable, see logs/latest.log.
msg.stta.engine_failed: Speech engine failed to start, see speech-to-text/logs.
msg.stta.timeout: Speech engine took too long, nothing sent.
stta.setup.title: Speech To Text: setup
stta.setup.intro: Hold a key, talk, and your words are typed into chat. Speech is recognised on this computer by a built-in engine — your voice never leaves your PC. A speech model is downloaded once from HuggingFace (the official whisper.cpp models).
stta.setup.ready: Ready! Running on %s. In a world, hold %s and talk.
config.stta.title: Speech To Text Accessibility
config.stta.open_setup_description: Download a different model, pick a microphone, or switch between graphics card and CPU.
config.stta.chat_input_mode_description:
Send: sends the message as soon as you release the key.

Open in chat box: puts the text in the chat box so you can edit it first.
config.stta.live_preview_description: Show your words above the hotbar while you speak.
config.stta.chat_prefix_description: Text put in front of every spoken message, e.g. "🔊 ". Empty = plain chat.
config.stta.max_seconds_description: Recording stops and sends by itself after this long.
config.stta.message_gap_description: Long speech is split into several chat messages. This pause between them keeps servers from kicking you for spam.
config.stta.language_description: 'game' follows Minecraft's language, 'auto' detects it each time, or a code like en, nl, fr, de, es, pt, pl, lt, ja. A fixed language is more reliable for short phrases.
config.stta.translate_description: Whatever language you speak, send it as English.
config.stta.prompt_description: Example text in your style; helps with punctuation and the spelling of game words. Keep it short and natural: whisper can copy prompt text when audio is unclear.
config.stta.beam_description: Higher is more accurate on release but slower. The live preview always uses the fast setting.
config.stta.preview_on_cpu_description: When the graphics card does the main recognition, run the live preview on a small CPU model so it doesn't take frames from the game (needs the 60 MB preview model).
config.stta.idle_minutes_description: Unload the speech model after this many minutes without talking, to give its memory back. The next key press loads it again (a few seconds).
config.stta.external_server_description: Use your own whisper.cpp whisper-server instead of the built-in engine, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080. Leave empty for the built-in engine.
stta.quality.accurate.desc: large-v3-turbo: the most accurate, any language. Needs a graphics card (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel Arc or Apple Silicon).
stta.quality.balanced.desc: small: good accuracy, fine on most CPUs and integrated graphics.
stta.quality.light.desc: base: fastest and least accurate, for older or slow PCs.
